description: This file defines the ThemeImage class within the OrangeHRM project, specifically in the CorporateBranding DTO (Data Transfer Object) namespace. It manages information related to theme images, including image content, filename, file type, and size, and provides methods to access and manipulate this data.

classes.name: ThemeImage
classes.description: A data transfer object representing an image used in theme customization, including properties for content, filename, file type, and size, along with methods to access and convert this data.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a ThemeImage object with content, filename, file type, and size.

methods.name: getContent
methods.description: Returns the content of the image as a string, reading from resource if necessary.

methods.name: getFilename
methods.description: Returns the filename of the image.

methods.name: getFileType
methods.description: Returns the file type (MIME type) of the image.

methods.name: getFileSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the image file.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the ThemeImage object contains any data.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Serializes the ThemeImage properties into an array.

methods.name: createFromArray
methods.description: Creates a ThemeImage object from an associative array.
